title: Allow 64-bit sparse array indices in SpectralEmbedding with ARPACK solver
answers: Why does SpectralEmbedding raise ValueError about 64-bit sparse indices under sparse_interface sparray?
How to fix 64-bit sparse array index errors in SpectralClustering with arpack solver?
When can accept_large_sparse=False be dropped from check_array in scikit-learn?
body:
Symptom: Fitting SpectralEmbedding or SpectralClustering under config_context(sparse_interface="sparray") with eigen_solver="arpack" raises a ValueError about 64-bit sparse indices.
Root cause: sklearn/manifold/_spectral_embedding.py:_spectral_embedding passed accept_large_sparse=False to check_array, rejecting int64 indices from SciPy csr_array even though scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh supports them.
Fix pattern: Remove accept_large_sparse=False from check_array so it defaults to True when downstream solvers support 64-bit indices.
Constraints: Only apply when downstream routines accept int64 indices (like eigsh); keep accept_large_sparse=False when passing data to Cython/C code requiring 32-bit index buffers.
applies: Validating sparse matrices or arrays in SpectralEmbedding and SpectralClustering with ARPACK solver.
